## Workflow
Keep the original log text unchanged. Call evoforge-log-summary with the text field. Record INFO, WARN, ERROR and malformed counts.
## Validation
Perform line-accounting: the sum of all level counts plus malformed must equal the number of nonempty input lines. Report malformed entries explicitly.
## Limitations
Only UTC timestamps and three uppercase levels are supported. Numeric counts are exact for this format; other formats require a separate capability.
